Packages to install if needed

```{r}
# install usethis - allows you to open and edit .Renviron
install.packages("usethis")

```



# Register with LPSN

Allows you to use the API rather than manually searching for each taxa.

Register here and ensure you record your login and password details: 

https://sso.dsmz.de/auth/realms/DSMZ/login-actions/registration?client_id=api.lpsn&tab_id=rb9JUBcCrvY


# Add LPSN registration details to your .Renviron file

Add your LPSN login details to your R environment. The API call needs a valid login to allow direct access to the database. The code needs to access the user name and password directly from the .Renviron file

_How to add the LPSN login details to R:_

```{r}

usethis::edit_r_environ() 

```

When your personal .Renviron file opens, add the following API key - has to be the same login details used when registering with LPSN.

DSMZ_API_USER="email_address" 
DSMZ_API_PASSWORD="password"


# Restart R and check details in .Renviron file:

_Restart r_

Via RStudio keyboard shortcut:
  - Windows/Linux: Ctrl + Shift + F10
  - macOS: Cmd + Shift + F10
  
From RStudio menu:
  - Session → Restart R
  


Once R restarted, check details were saved correctly to the .Renviron file

```{r}

utils::file.edit("~/.Renviron")

```



_install the LPSN R client package_

The R package that provides the rules to access the LPSN database needs to be installed and loaded before you can access the data.

To check package status: https://r-forge.r-project.org/R/?group_id=1573

as at Nov 2026, R-Forge has announced that it will shut down. Check on the LPSN site for the current R API Client repository:

General info - https://lpsn.dsmz.de/text/lpsn-api

Current API page -  https://api.lpsn.dsmz.de/?pk_vid=c87dd9ccc4fe0391179444961377ea6d 




```{r}

	utils::install.packages("LPSN", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org")

```


If .Renviron is correct, and the LPSN package is installed, move onto the the taxa clean up and API calls:
LPSN_Processing_taxa_list.Rmd
